notes: AWAITING FOUNDER LOCK — spec + mockup authored 2026-08-15, no implementation started. Triggered by a real defect report: a collab request sent to Sagar Joshi was invisible to the creator. IN: (a) invitations from brands and pitches to brands become two front stages of the Collabs tab, threaded one-row-per-brand-conversation; (b) every next step — accept, decline, negotiate — spelled out for both directions; (c) symmetric negotiation, i.e. the creator can counter the brand's counter on their own pitch, which does not exist today. OUT: tab-bar unread badge (no badge mechanism exists; touches all four apps), creator web surface (none exists — Part 6 recorded that mistake), open-campaign application (still deferred per Part 6 §6.3).

founder_decisions_2026_08_15.threading: One thread per brand — request -> agreement -> campaign is ONE row telling one story, not three rows in three lists. Chosen over two separate sections and a flat list.
founder_decisions_2026_08_15.negotiation: Symmetric — the creator can counter back on their own pitch, under the same round limits as the handshake. Chosen over keeping accept/decline, and over deferring the backend to a later slice.

audit_2026_08_15.finding_1: THE REQUEST WAS NEVER LOST, IT WAS NEVER REACHABLE. Prod holds 2 brand_collab_requests, both status='sent'; the founder's row targets influencer 070418e5 = Sagar Joshi (sagartravel), 15% commission, post by 2026-08-24, scope 'bottom wear'. A collab_request.received notification exists for Sagar's user, unread. viewed_at is NULL on BOTH rows — and listCreatorRequests flips sent->viewed on first read (handshake.controller.js:347), so that endpoint has never been called on that account. The screen was not opened-and-empty; it was never opened. Only entry: Profile tab -> 'Brand Outreach' -> 'Brand Proposals' (subtitle still 'DISCOVER + TRACK PITCHES', written before brands could ask anyone) -> third tab REQUESTS, unbadged, behind a hub that opens on DISCOVER. InfluencerNavigator.js:67 registers ProposalsHub in the Profile stack; ProfileScreen.js:513 is the sole tap-through.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_2: THE TWO DIRECTIONS ARE NOT SYMMETRIC AND THE OUTGOING ONE IS A DEAD END. brand_collab_requests supports counters from both sides with 2 rounds each (brand_rounds_used / creator_rounds_used / counter_by). influencer_proposals supports counters from the BRAND ONLY: the creator's sole reply is respond-counter with action in {accept, decline} (proposal.controller.js:195-198). There is no round limit on the brand side at all, so a brand may counter forever. There is also no creator-facing detail screen — getMyProposal exists server-side and mobile never calls it, and listMyAgreements (api.js:395) is likewise never called, so an accepted pitch produces an agreement the creator is never shown.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_3: A BRAND CAN ACCEPT TERMS NOBODY OFFERED. acceptProposal calls acceptedFlow(proposal, useCounterTerms=false) (proposal.controller.js:295) — brand acceptance always settles the creator's ORIGINAL terms. Correct today only because the creator can never counter. The moment finding_2 is fixed, a brand pressing Accept after the creator moved to 14,000 would silently agree 20,000. A latent defect that this contract's own change would arm, so it is fixed in the same contract rather than shipped.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_4: THREADING IS ALREADY POSSIBLE IN THE SCHEMA AND USED NOWHERE. brand_collab_requests.id -> collab_agreements.source_request_id / source_proposal_id -> campaign_influencers.agreement_id (+ consumed_ci_id). Every link exists from migration 149. No endpoint and no screen walks it, so a creator who agreed terms and then receives that brand's campaign sees two unrelated things in two unrelated places.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_6: THE BRAND DIRECTORY IS EFFECTIVELY EMPTY. Prod holds 26 brands and exactly ONE has accepts_proposals=TRUE — 'Aveen food paradise', category restaurant, with users.city NULL and brands.locality NULL. Zero fashion brands are pitchable. So the industry facet offers one value (restaurant) and the area facet offers none: a creator opening 'Find brands to pitch' sees a single restaurant with no location. Not a bug — accepts_proposals defaults false and Part 2 deliberately made brands opt in while creators are reachable by default. The consequence is that the creator's outbound route has been shipped and unusable since it was built. Needs a founder decision (spec 1.6 options A/B/C); slice 9 is blocked on it.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_7: DISCOVERY FILTERS THE WRONG COLUMN, AND THAT COLUMN IS DIRTY. discoverEligibleBrands (proposal.service.js:217-243) touches exactly one geo field, users.city — free text, NULL for 10 of 26 brands, and holding BOTH 'Vijayawada' (5) and 'Vijaywada' (1) as separate facet entries for one city, plus 'Tadepalle' which is a locality filed as a city. Meanwhile brands carries structured geo that discovery never reads: locality (12/26 — HITEC City, Jubilee Hills, Indiranagar, Bandra, Gachibowli), pincode (11/26), lat/lng (13/26), formatted_address (7/26). The 'area' filter the founder asked for already exists in the data, on a column nothing queries.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_8: ELIGIBILITY IS CHECKED ON SUBMIT, AFTER THE WORK. checkEligibility exists and returns a usable reason string, but runs only at createProposal. A creator picks a brand, writes a title, message, terms, deliverables and three portfolio links, presses Send, and is told 'this brand only accepts proposals from macro tier and above'. discoverEligibleBrands' own comment states it: 'Return all listed brands; eligibility is checked per-brand on submit.'
audit_2026_08_15.finding_9: THE PITCH AND THE INVITATION SPEAK DIFFERENT LANGUAGES FOR THE SAME ENUM. SendProposalScreen labels the aim 'ENGAGEMENT (FEE)' / 'CONVERSION (COMM)' / 'HYBRID'; CollabRequestDetailScreen labels the identical campaign_goal enum 'Pay for content' / 'Pay per sale' / 'Fee + commission'. One creator, two directions, two vocabularies — the duplicated-vocabulary fault Part 2 caught twice. The pitch also carries NO requirement/preference marker, so symmetric negotiation would have no rules to enforce on that side.
audit_2026_08_15.finding_5: PALETTE TRAP. CollabsListScreen renders in theme/ig (white/black restyle). ProposalsHubScreen, CollabRequestDetailScreen and CollabPreferencesScreen all render in theme/tokens brandPalette (yellow). Moving them into Collabs without restyling would put a yellow screen one tap inside a white-and-black tab.

open_decision_accepts_proposals.question: 26 brands, 1 pitchable. Should approved brands be pitchable by default?
open_decision_accepts_proposals.option_a_recommended: Migration flipping accepts_proposals=true for status='approved' brands, per-brand toggle unchanged. Mirrors the creator side. NOTE: outward-facing — 25 brands go from unreachable to reachable at once and some will first notice via a pitch notification. Reverses a deliberate Part 2 asymmetry, so it is the founder's call and must not ride in quietly on a UI contract.
open_decision_accepts_proposals.option_b: Surface the toggle in brand onboarding and settings so brands opt in knowingly. Honest, slower, depends on brands acting.
open_decision_accepts_proposals.option_c: Leave it. Discovery ships correct and empty; filters tested against one restaurant.
open_decision_accepts_proposals.blocks: slice 9 only — slices 7 and 8 are correct and shippable either way

release.deploy_class: production-impacting (migration 152 + backend/src + brand-web runtime + Mobile runtime) — explicit founder go required BEFORE the push, per feedback-push-is-the-deploy
release.released_note: Stays false. Per feedback_e2e_verification_at_end the founder verifies this with the rest of the redesign in one end-to-end pass. Worth a device pass even if the rest waits.
